mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low interest rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic recovery, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and INDPRO show positive growth (e.g., both above their 3-month moving average), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 3.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the short term as central banks raise rates, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (computed from GDPC1) signals economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and labor market health, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both PAYEMS and RSAFS show positive growth (e.g., both above their 3-month moving average), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500.0 (thousands of units) signals weakening demand in the residential sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1500.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
